en-US.name: CodeShip Builder
en-US.summary: Build web app plans by voice using Alexa and Amazon Bedrock
en-US.description: CodeShip is a voice-first app builder prototype. Say 'build hostel management system' to create a project plan using Amazon Bedrock when configured. GitHub publishing and deployment require connected credentials.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Enable the skill in the Alexa Developer Console test tab. Say 'open code ship' then 'build hostel management system'. Configure the Lambda ARN and BEDROCK_MODEL_ID first.
